Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

ContiTech is one of the world’s leading material experts for industry applications. The Continental group sector offers its customers reliable, safe and convenient industry and service solutions using a range of materials for off-highway applications, on rails and roads, in the air, under and above the ground, in industrial environments, for the food sector and the furniture industry. With about 20,000 employees (Status as of March 2026) at more than 60 sites globally, and sales of some 6.0 billion euros (2025), the global industrial partner is active with core branches in Asia, Europe and North and South America.

Job Description

We're looking for a motivated Antitrust Compliance Specialist (m/f/diverse) who is passionate about antitrust compliance and eager to contribute to global initiatives, foster knowledge sharing, and support the ongoing development of our compliance framework.

Your tasks will include the following activities:

- Taking an active role in enhancing and continuously improving ContiTech’s compliance program, particularly with respect to antitrust compliance
- Identifying opportunities to further strengthen the antitrust compliance program through active collaboration and communication with the regions
- Enhancing the concept for association activities and serving as the point of contact for related inquiries from all stakeholders
- Further developing the global antitrust risk assessment process and acting as the point of contact for antitrust-related questions
- Drafting, reviewing, and updating group policies and guidelines related to antitrust compliance
- Managing the rollout of global antitrust initiatives
- Developing content for antitrust training and other preventive measures in close collaboration with relevant departments
- Delivering antitrust training to all ContiTech business areas and central functions
- Designing and implementing additional mitigation measures, such as internal controls and monitoring activities
- Leading lessons-learned projects and driving ongoing improvements to the effectiveness of the antitrust Compliance Management System (CMS)
- Monitoring regulatory developments, best practices, industry trends, and compliance-related topics
- Developing and maintaining a knowledge-sharing concept for antitrust compliance, ensuring that all materials remain relevant and up to date
- Responding to external third-party audits of the ContiTech compliance program

Qualifications

- Qualification as a fully qualified lawyer (First and Second State Examination) is required
- Several years of professional experience in antitrust law and/or compliance, preferably gained in an international company, law firm, or auditing firm
- Additional experience in anti-money laundering (AML) is considered an advantage
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
- Business-fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; additional language skills are a plus
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills combined with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset
- Strong intercultural competence and experience working across functions and international corporate structures
- Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style
- Willingness to travel internationally

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Engineer Logistics Inbound & Outbound (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Pharmatechnik)
jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

As a Senior Process Engineer Logistics Inbound & Outbound (m/f/d) specializing in pharmaceutical and biotechnological process design, you will be part of a highly qualified team at the regional office in Bad Homburg or Stuttgart, Germany, where knowledge transfer and collaborative work are considered essential. You will work in an international environment with open-minded, professional, and engaged colleagues, within a culture of continuous improvement and development.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead logistics process planning for inbound, automated warehousing, robotics, outbound, and intra-production logistics in biotechnological manufacturing environments.
- Manage all planning phases, including budget responsibility, from feasibility and concept design through detailed design, construction, commissioning, and qualification.
- Gather and assess customer requirements, develop concepts, and present solutions to internal and external stakeholders.
- Create layout drawings, block and process flow diagrams covering personnel, material, and waste flows.
- Prepare technical and commercial documentation (URS, TS) and support logistics equipment and IT software selection through technical and commercial bid evaluations.
- Coordinate interdisciplinary teams and collaborate with internal engineering disciplines and external suppliers for automated warehouse and robotics solutions.
- Lead or support logistics process engineering teams during project execution, including risk analyses (HAZID, HAZOP) and move-in concepts for critical equipment.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, or a related field.
- Professional experience in logistics engineering projects, ideally with at least 5 years of relevant experience.
- Strong understanding of logistics processes combined with high IT affinity and experience with transport and warehouse management systems such as SAP IM/WM or similar.
- Professional in MS Project, Auto CAD, 2D/ 3D Layout modelling is an advantage
- Strong leadership capabilities with a professional, supportive, and results-driven approach in project environments.
- Analytical and solution-oriented mindset with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse international stakeholders.
- Self-driven, detail-oriented, and resilient team player with fluent German and English skills, both written and spoken.
- Willingness to travel up to 30% and to provide on-site support during project commissioning when required.

What we offer you

- Growth opportunities in an interesting and complex industry sector.
- Bring in your ideas and proposal to shape the success of Process Engineer Logistics and Packaging at Exyte.
- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues.
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarization with your colleagues in the team.
- Catering: Free coffee specialties as well as water dispensers are accessible.
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidies your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany.

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.
